title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldier Field on 1994-07-24

ai_review.summary: Recording source unknown; show features a nice Eyes > Eternity > He's Gone run but is overall described as lethargic and uneven.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews are split – one enthusiastically rates the concert five stars, while two criticize it for being laid‑back to the point of boredom, noting weak performances on songs like "Shoe Fits" and a botched "Roses." The only clear musical highlight mentioned is the "Eyes > Eternity > He's Gone" sequence, and reviewers give no details about the audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Mixed show feedback with one positive outlier; lack of recording comments limits confidence, leading to a modest rating reflecting overall lukewarm reception.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentioned soundboard, audience, or any audio clarity issues; recording quality cannot be assessed from the provided comments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as laid‑back and lethargic, with a sleepy second half after the Space jam; overall engagement was low according to reviewers.
